facts.fact: 本章开篇：Caroline 头痛欲裂，身体其余部分麻木得像个空壳
facts.anchor: My head throbbed, but the rest of me was numb, an empty shell.

facts.fact: 判决不利于她：法官小组认定她要为「嫁给一个欺骗她的男人」这个选择付出代价，直到死为止
facts.anchor: a panel of judges had decided that I was to pay for that choice until the day I died.

facts.fact: 归途马车上，Orson 在对面座位默默解开腿上的绷带，自她离开法院后一言不发
facts.anchor: Orson, now stretched out on the carriage seat opposite from me, was slowly and silently unwinding the bandages from his leg.

facts.fact: 她在心里列出关心自己的人：Zane、Gertrude 和父亲，据此确认自己并非完全孤立
facts.anchor: No, that wasn’t true. Zane cared. Gertrude cared. My father cared.

facts.fact: 她的盘算是先顺抚丈夫，指望他放过 Zane
facts.anchor: if I pacified him, hopefully he would leave Zane alone.

facts.fact: Orson 预告：一周之内 Zane 将不再是个问题
facts.anchor: By this time next week Zane Bishop won’t be a problem ever again.

facts.fact: 当夜逃出宅邸后，Caroline 打算天亮去码头搭第一艘船远走
facts.anchor: I’m going to the docks. In the morning, I’ll jump aboard the first ship headed far, far away.

facts.fact: 结尾她拉着 Zane 一起驾马车，去跟踪深夜外出的 Orson
facts.anchor: Let’s take it and see what my husband is up to.
